#### Import packages

```{r, message=FALSE}
library("tidyverse")
library("curl")
```

#### Load the datasets

```{r}
file_names <- c(
  "77_cancer_proteomes_CPTAC_itraq.csv",
  "clinical_data_breast_cancer.csv",
  "PAM50_proteins.csv"
)

curl_download(url = "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/piotrgrabo/breastcancerproteomes",
              destfile = "../data/raw_/breastcancerproteomes.zip")
unzip("data/_raw/breastcancerproteomes.zip",
      exdir = "data/_raw")
file.remove("data/_raw/breastcancerproteomes.zip")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
proteomes <- read_csv(file_names[1], show_col_types = FALSE)
clinical  <- read_csv(file_names[2], show_col_types = FALSE)
pam50     <- read_csv(file_names[3], show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
head(proteomes)
```

#### Save to 01_load.csv

```{r}
write.csv()
```
